resources.description: At most eight entries may be Memory Stores; Memory Stores attach only at creation.

type.description: api_error may appear only in histories written before the terminal Session error contract.

SessionThreadAgent.description: The immutable Agent snapshot executing this Thread, or the exact platform advisor form for an automatically terminating consultation.
